title: Aydencraft
description: Aydencraft is a smp with many cool custom features
body:
Our SMP delivers a fair and exciting survival experience built around community and creativity.

🌲 Features:

• Classic Survival with economy

• Land claim / grief protection

• Community projects & events

• Active staff team

• Friendly Discord community

• End opens on 28.04.2026 4 pm (UTC+1)

Play solo or team up with friends and build your own empire.

Be part of something bigger — join today!
